title: Function-Verb Structures
summary: Using common noun-verb combinations for precise formal and economic communication.
whyItMatters: Function-verb structures package actions into conventional formal expressions and help speakers control emphasis, register, and sentence structure.

mentalModel.title: The noun carries the core meaning
mentalModel.content: In eine Entscheidung treffen, the noun Entscheidung expresses the main action while treffen completes the fixed structure.

mentalModel.title: Learn the whole combination
mentalModel.content: Article, preposition, case, and verb are part of the expression and cannot be freely exchanged.

ruleBlocks.title: Treat combinations as lexical units
ruleBlocks.content: Learn forms such as Maßnahmen ergreifen, Einfluss nehmen auf, and zur Verfügung stehen with their complements.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect them to simple verbs
ruleBlocks.content: Compare eine Entscheidung treffen with entscheiden and in Betracht ziehen with berücksichtigen.

ruleBlocks.title: Use them where formality helps
ruleBlocks.content: Prefer a simple verb when the function-verb structure adds no precision, emphasis, or appropriate register.

examples.de: Das Unternehmen ergreift Maßnahmen gegen Lieferausfälle.
examples.en: The company is taking measures against supply failures.

examples.de: Bei der Auswahl sollten auch soziale Standards in Betracht gezogen werden.
examples.en: Social standards should also be considered in the selection.

examples.de: Für kurzfristige Bestellungen stehen nur begrenzte Kapazitäten zur Verfügung.
examples.en: Only limited capacity is available for short-term orders.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use machen with every action noun.
commonMistakes.correct: Learn the conventional verb used with each noun.

commonMistakes.wrong: Stack formal structures in every sentence.
commonMistakes.correct: Alternate them with clear simple verbs.
commonMistakes.reason: Excessive nominal style makes prose heavy.

comparisons.summary: Economic reports supply recurring formal collocations and institutional actions.
Negotiators use these structures to formulate proposals, decisions, and obligations precisely.
